statusSemantics.assigned: The specification maps the obligation to concrete target evidence; no test execution or pass result is claimed.
statusSemantics.executed_passed: All mapped evidence has been produced and every stated oracle has passed on the recorded build and platform.
statusSemantics.failed: At least one mapped test or oracle was executed and did not satisfy the stated behavior.
statusSemantics.blocked: Execution cannot currently complete and the blocking condition is recorded in the acceptance report.
statusSemantics.unresolved: The obligation lacks an explicit test or oracle allocation; unresolved is forbidden for this locked registry.

obligations.behavior: A no-op save and reload preserves adjacent collection entries, their integer references, shared resources, and every scene root without index drift.
Deleting or compacting an object next to another index never aliases the removed EditorObjectId to the adjacent survivor or to a later generation.
Adjacent hierarchy rows, scene roots, and grouped resource rows expose the exact document counts and preorder sequence while expand, scroll, and focus preserve selection.

Same-parent and root-to-root drops keep collection order unchanged but record their exact command envelopes; a cross-parent drop and its Undo or Redo append at the destination tail rather than restoring an adjacent sibling slot.

Editing one material field, extension, or variant selection leaves adjacent material, texture, variant mapping, unknown-extension, and extras values unchanged while updating only the selected authored record.
Assign, Split, and Merge preserve primitive order and shared accessor or geometry relationships when neighboring primitives use the same or different materials.
Editing or applying one camera addresses the selected camera and node only; adjacent perspective and orthographic camera entries retain their authored values and order.
Creating, switching, or deleting one punctual light keeps adjacent light and node references valid, including multiple nodes that reference neighboring light definitions.
For each adjacent parent-child pair, effective visibility is the conjunction of authored values along that exact ancestor chain and does not suppress an unrelated sibling branch.
Scene-level transform applies the frozen baseline independently to every adjacent root, including mixed TRS and matrix roots, without cross-scene contamination.
Adjacent compatible commands coalesce only under the 500 ms contract, while an adjacent incompatible command remains a separate entry with exact Undo and Redo descriptions.
Deltas for adjacent document revisions and neighboring objects retain valid source-target revision chains and update only their corresponding runtime records.
Save As stages same-named and adjacent external resources without overwriting the wrong file, and the published glTF references each staged resource exactly.
Merge and Compact remap every adjacent standard and known-extension index, preserve survivor relationships, and choose only a genuinely equivalent shared-mesh merge candidate.
Switching between adjacent scene radio rows renders the selected scene exactly once while leaving defaultScene, document data, and UndoStack unchanged.
Node counts immediately below, at, and above the 65,536 limit accept 65,536 and atomically reject the 65,537th add or merge with all active hashes unchanged.
TRS editing accepts finite positive, zero, and negative scale, preserves continuous Euler behavior across plus or minus 180 degrees, and atomically rejects NaN, infinity, or non-finite matrices.
Gizmo hit and drag math remains finite for near-parallel rays, viewport-edge coordinates, negative parent scale, orthographic projection, and grid units 0.001, 1, and 1000.
Every exposed core and extension material numeric field is tested below, at, and above its legal endpoints; only valid min, mid, and max values commit and reload.
Perspective and orthographic camera edits reject values at or beyond invalid plane and magnitude boundaries while preserving omitted perspective zfar and omitted aspectRatio semantics.
Punctual light range 0 retains undefined or infinite meaning, and spot cones enforce 0 <= inner < outer <= pi/2 without NaN or an inverted cone at any edge.
Scene Transform identity and Reset return every root to its frozen baseline, while a non-decomposable root matrix remains safely authored as a matrix.
History tests distinguish 499, 500, and 501 ms coalescing cases and the 100th versus 101st command while preserving the exact surviving stack and descriptions.
Capacity and responsiveness cover 0, 1, 10,000, 65,535, 65,536, and 65,537 nodes with exact accept or reject outcomes and the locked p95 budgets.
A background load, projection, or upload candidate cannot expose a partially parsed document over the active lossless model; only a complete matching candidate may publish.
A pick, selection, command, or renderer handle captured before delete, Merge, Compact, or document replacement is rejected when its generation, document, or revision is stale.
External focus, list scrolling, tab changes, and selection updates in one UI frame converge on one selected stable ID without forcing a Scene Browser tab switch.
Within the double-click window the picker emits exactly one delayed single-click action or one double-click camera action, and all selection consumers observe one end-of-frame revision.
A hierarchy command whose object ID or document revision becomes stale between preflight and commit fails atomically with document, runtime, history, and selection unchanged.
A continuous TRS edit and animation or frame projection update obey the locked edit-conflict policy and publish one internally consistent descendant, camera, light, and instance transform set.
Simultaneous Gizmo hover or drag, viewport picking, ImGui capture, and camera navigation yield one input owner and one transform preview for the frame.
Continuous material edits coalesce to the latest revision at a frame-safe boundary without full geometry or texture upload, device idle, or a partially updated material state.
Clipboard Paste revalidates the canonical material index against the active document at click time, so a document switch cannot apply a stable ID or material from the previous document.
Apply to Current View or Set from Current View uses one matching camera, node world transform, viewport, and document revision even if a scene or camera selection changes nearby.
Light create, type switch, edit, and delete publish a coherent CPU and GPU light record on the next frame and never leave a stale slot during an overlapping frame consume.
Visibility edit and reparent publish authored hierarchy and effective draw flags as one revision, never exposing a frame with visibility computed from the old parent and topology from the new parent.
Adding, deleting, or reparenting a root during a Scene Transform edit freezes the applied result, resets popup TRS, and installs the new baseline atomically.
A completed control deactivation or Gizmo release records one command at its defined event boundary; concurrent Undo, new-command branching, or history clear cannot observe a half command.

Renderer consumption discards stale or duplicate deltas and swaps a FullRebuild candidate exactly once only after projection and GPU resources are complete, with old resources retained through their fence.
Escape-only, Escape plus release in one frame, focus loss with or without synthetic release, and a late release follow the exact mutually exclusive commit or no-history branches.
A write, flush, close, rename, cross-volume publish, or process-interruption failure during Save As leaves the old target and active dirty, path, and history state intact.
Merge or Compact commits only against the source document revision it validated; an invalid, over-limit, or stale background candidate cannot replace or partially mutate active state.
Rapid Open A then B, close during load, invalid recent paths, and candidate load or upload failures obey the controller queue or latest-request contract without a half lifecycle or use-after-free.
Modal, busy transaction, text input, menu, toolbar, and shortcut routing consume each physical input event at most once and expose no reference-absent cancel or unsaved prompt.
Background topology or FullRebuild preparation keeps large-list interaction bounded and the last valid scene usable until one frame-safe publish, without full-scene work on continuous edit frames.
A valid document with zero scenes, zero roots, or absent optional collections can load, no-op save, and reload without synthesizing authored objects or losing unknown data.
An empty ID registry and mapping table return typed absence for lookups, selection, and stale handles and never manufacture index zero as an object.
With no document or with zero entries in any resource group, Scene Browser shows the reference empty state, exact zero counts, valid tabs, and no selectable display-only placeholder.
Hierarchy operations handle an empty scene root list and an empty rename string exactly: valid Add creates the first root, while an empty-name Rename is a no-op with focus restored.

A material with no textures, optional extensions, or variant mappings preserves their absence, exposes the correct controls, and can add then remove each supported extension without disturbing siblings.
No material, no equivalent merge candidate, and an empty clipboard each produce the specified disabled or informed no-op state without deleting resources or changing history.
With no camera selection or no camera objects, camera Inspector and Apply or Set controls expose the reference empty and disabled state without altering the viewport or document.
A document with no KHR_lights_punctual definition or light nodes can create the first point, directional, or spot light from each specified entry and reload it validly.
A node with no KHR_node_visibility extension is effectively visible, displays Add Visibility, and preserves extension absence until the user explicitly authors it.
A scene with zero roots has an empty baseline set; opening, resetting, or freezing Scene Transform does not create nodes, history, or a non-identity document mutation.
Undo and Redo on empty stacks remain disabled and leave document hash, revisions, selection, stack sizes, and next descriptions unchanged.
An empty SceneChangeSet is accepted as a no-op, produces no GPU upload or rebuild, and does not advance projection or publish revision.
Save As with no external resources stages only the target glTF or GLB, while a canceled native dialog leaves path, dirty state, history, target files, and recent files unchanged.
Merge and Compact handle an incoming document with empty collections and an active document with no unreachable resources without invalid remaps or unintended deletion.
NoDocument, unload, close, and a valid document containing zero scenes transition through the specified lifecycle states without exposing a stale selection, Gizmo, camera, or render scene.
The no-document UI has exact menu, shortcut, toolbar, panel, modal, and error enablement and does not show an invented dirty badge, unsaved prompt, or Compact confirmation.
A zero-object document and empty visible-resource lists remain responsive, allocate bounded editor state, and perform no per-frame full-list rebuild or GPU upload.
CJK, emoji, combining-character, empty, and very long UTF-8 object names display with intact document strings, deterministic rows, and ellipsis plus tooltip where clipping is required.
Rename accepts and round-trips CJK, emoji, and combining UTF-8 names without truncating the document value, while an empty name follows the reference no-op behavior.
Unicode and long names or paths remain legible across all locked DPI and viewport sizes, with correct Windows wide-character boundaries and no text overlap or document-string mutation.
Repeating load, no-op save, and reload on an unedited glTF or GLB preserves the same semantic digest, authored values, binary payload hashes, and active scene each time.
Repeated lookup or use of the same stale EditorObjectId remains invalid and never rebinds after generation reuse, Undo restoration, Merge, or Compact.
Repeated external focus, expand, collapse, scroll-to, or display-only row actions do not create a new selection revision, force a tab switch, or alter document state.
Setting the same selection payload twice emits no redundant selection change, while the explicitly non-idempotent second viewport click on the unique same Primitive performs exactly one clear toggle.

Repeated invalid or stale hierarchy commands remain atomic no-ops; each reference-defined same-parent Move, root-to-root Move, or unique-root Delete keeps the document unchanged while applying only its exact selection, redo, and history envelope.
Submitting an unchanged valid TRS or repeating a rejected non-finite value leaves document revision, matrices, runtime digest, and history unchanged after the first outcome.
A second release, repeated Escape detach, or late release after a completed or detached Gizmo drag cannot add another transform command or change the retained final TRS.
Setting a material field or active variant to its current value, adding an already-authored extension, or removing an absent extension produces no extra revision, delta, upload, or history entry.
Repeated Copy, invalid Paste, same-material assignment, or Merge with no equivalent candidate leaves document and Undo or Redo counts unchanged and never deletes a resource.
Repeated Apply to Current View changes no document data, and repeating Set from an unchanged view introduces no numeric drift, authored optional field, or history entry.
Repeating an unchanged light edit or retrying a stale delete does not duplicate light definitions, renderer slots, deltas, or history and preserves the node's local minus-Z direction.
Repeatedly applying the same authored visibility or recomputing the same ancestor chain leaves document revision and GPU resource handles unchanged and emits no redundant history entry.
Repeated Scene Transform Reset or identity application returns the same baseline digest, and 1,000 back-and-forth transforms do not accumulate additional drift or history.
Undo at the oldest state, Redo at the newest state, and repeated history clear remain no-ops with exact stack counts, next descriptions, revisions, selection, and document hash.
A duplicate or already-consumed SceneChangeSet and a repeated publish of the same revision are ignored without another upload, rebuild, resource retirement, or projection revision.
After Escape-only detaches an active drag, repeated Escape and every repeated late release keep selection clear, preview TRS retained, and transform history unchanged.
Repeating Save As to the same valid content produces a semantically equivalent reload, does not add history, and leaves no stale staging files or duplicate recent-file entry.
A second Compact on the already compacted document is a complete no-op with identical document, mapping, render, selection, and history digests.
Selecting the already-current scene or repeating a completed unload or close produces no document mutation, defaultScene change, history entry, duplicate publish, or stale UI state.
Repeatedly opening or focusing Scene Browser, Inspector, or Grid and Snap reuses the same window state, and a repeated identical toggle never creates duplicate UI instances or dispatches.
Repeated attempts to exceed any resource limit are rejected in bounded time with identical document, projection, render, selection, and history hashes and no allocation growth.
No-op round-trip preserves the exact order of scenes, roots, children, primitives, resources, skins, animations, and all integer reference arrays; unordered comparison is not accepted.
After every randomized add, duplicate, delete, reparent, Undo, Redo, Merge, and Compact step, forward and reverse mappings enumerate objects in the same deterministic document and runtime order.
Asset headers, Release and Debug tabs, Scene Graph preorder, eight Scene List groups, and Multiple Scenes radios appear in the exact specified conditional order.
Hierarchy execute, Undo, and Redo use reference append-only order for cross-parent moves, preserve no-op same-parent and root order, and save or reload the final exact sequence.
Material edits preserve material, texture, primitive, variant mapping, and extension-array order through Add, Remove, variant application, Undo, Redo, renderer update, save, and reload.
Assign, Duplicate Material, Split, and Merge maintain exact primitive order, append new resources deterministically, and remap selection before any orphan resource is removed.
Camera list order and camera-to-node references remain exact after property edits, Apply, Set, save, and reload for mixed perspective and orthographic entries.
Light definitions, their nodes, and renderer slots follow deterministic append and removal order across all three creation entries, type switches, delete, Undo, Redo, and reload.
Effective visibility traversal follows exact scene-root and child order after reparent, while hidden branches suppress draws without reordering surviving document or GPU resources.
Scene Transform baseline capture, hierarchy freeze, and Reset iterate roots in document order and never reorder roots while applying sceneTRS times baselineLocal.
Execute, coalesce, Undo, Redo, branch, history clear, and clean-revision updates preserve the exact linear command order and matching menu description after every step.
Deltas for different objects retain deterministic production and consumption order; FullRebuild publishes the candidate before old-resource retirement and never reverses that sequence.
Save As validates, prepares all resources, writes, flushes, closes, atomically replaces, and only then updates path, clean revision, and recent-file MRU order.
Merge appends incoming collections deterministically under the named root, and Compact preserves the relative order of all reachable survivors while remapping every reference chain.
Open Recent remains MRU ordered, scene radios remain document ordered, and asynchronous lifecycle completions cannot publish an older request after the selected winning request.
A 10,000-row clipped list and a 65,536-node hierarchy retain exact document order through scrolling and incremental edits without traversal recursion changing visible-row sequence.
Quaternion-backed Euler edits preserve sign-equivalent normalized quaternions and local or world matrices within 1e-5, while edited document numerics reload within the specified 1e-9 tolerance.
Axis, plane, ring, and uniform-scale Gizmo results meet TRS tolerance; projected handle centers are within 2 logical pixels and hit regions within 3 logical pixels of the reference baseline.
Edited material values reload within 1e-9, float32-derived color or extension values within 1e-6, and unedited numeric values remain IEEE exact or meet the documented 1e-12 fallback.
Camera Apply and Set round-trip perspective or orthographic view and node transforms within matrix tolerance without manufacturing omitted zfar or aspectRatio values.
Light UI sRGB converts to document linear values within numeric tolerance, intensity units remain type-correct, and cone or range computations stay finite under transformed nodes.
After 1,000 scene-transform cycles and return to identity, every decomposable root matches its frozen baseline within 1e-5 and every non-decomposable matrix remains semantically intact.
Execute, coalesce, Undo, and Redo restore numeric document, projection, render, and selection state within each domain tolerance without cumulative transform or material drift.

Performance evidence uses the fixed machine and build identity, 120-frame warm-up, at least 300 samples, raw median, p95, and max values, exact counters, and the locked 4 ms, 2 ms, and 0.5 ms thresholds.
